# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_003_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 3

**1** Jesus said: "If those who lead [нетшооп] you say to you, 'See, the kingdom [тмнтеро] is in the sky [тпе],' then the birds of the sky will get there before you.

**2** If they say to you, 'It is in the sea,' then the fish will get there before you.

**3** Rather [алла], the kingdom is inside [нноун] you and outside [нвол] you.

**4** When you know [соун] yourselves, then you will be known, and you will understand that you are children [шнре] of the living [оноз] Father [еіот].

**5** But if you do not know yourselves, you are in poverty [хнке] and you are the poverty."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *тмнтеро*: kingdom, kingship, reign — the standard Coptic rendering of Greek βασιλεία
- *тпе*: sky, heaven; in Thomas "kingdom of heaven" typically avoids the phrase, preferring "kingdom of the Father"
- *нноун*: literally "inside," "within"; cf. P.Oxy 654 line 17: ἐντὸς ὑμῶν
- *нвол*: outside, without; the kingdom is both within and beyond the individual
- *соун*: to know, recognize — Coptic equivalent of Gnostic γνῶσις
- *шнре*: son/child (can be gender-neutral in Coptic); "sons" in older translations; "children" better reflects Coptic usage
- *хнке*: poverty, destitution — the opposite of the kingdom
- cf. P.Oxy 654 lines 9-21 for Greek parallel
